name: Tiszafüred (Hungary)
description: White field charged at the centre with the town arms of Tiszafüred: a green shield with white reeds, with red mantling, supported by two black birds, above a scroll inscribed TISZAFÜRED.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.

features.role: Tiszafüred arms with mantling, supporters and scroll
